input.text: I need to give a 10-minute talk to new users about skillpp. The material is in README.md. Propose the content for the slides — a title and 3 to 4 bullets per slide — but don't build anything yet.

steps.reply:
Proposed deck. 8 slides, ~75s each.

**Slide 1 — Skill++: Skills From Work You Already Did**
- Turn repeated Claude Code work into reviewable skills
- Local detection, frontier model only on demand
- Nothing installed without your say-so
- 10 min: problem → pipeline → install → review → privacy → limits

**Slide 2 — Problem**
- Agent skills make procedures reliable, but few people write them
- By the third time you do a thing, it's already worth a skill — and you've moved on
- Writing `SKILL.md` from scratch is the tax
- Skillpp watches, notices repeats, drafts from what you actually did

**Slide 3 — Pipeline (one diagram, five stages)**
- **Capture**: 4 Claude Code hooks, secrets/tokens/emails scrubbed on write
- **Cut**: local model splits ended session into tasks at each user prompt
- **Match**: embeddings compare against ledger; 3 hits → candidate
- **Draft**: your agent (`claude -p`) writes SKILL.md + open questions

**Slide 4 — Requirements**
- macOS/Linux, Python 3.10+ (stdlib only)
- Claude Code on PATH, logged in
- Ollama + `gemma4:e4b` (cutter/namer) + `nomic-embed-text` (matcher)
- ~8 GB free RAM while cutter loaded

**Slide 5 — Install & First Run**
- `pipx install git+https://github.com/himanshu096/skill-plus-plus`
- `skillpp install --project ~/code/repo --apply` (or `--user` for all projects)
- `skillpp doctor` → all green
- Restart Claude Code, work normal, then `skillpp web`

**Slide 6 — Review Page (`127.0.0.1:8765`)**
- **Candidates**: most-seen first, promote or dismiss at 3
- **Draft Skill**: hands first run to your agent, optional note for later-run lessons
- **Drafts**: rendered SKILL.md + open questions; download when answered
- **Revise**: send agent an instruction, updates draft in place
- Shortcut: `/skillpp-keep` in a session, or `SKILLPP_RECURRENCE=1` to skip the 3-repeat wait

**Slide 7 — Privacy**
- Everything stays in `~/.claude/skillpp/`, local models too
- Scrubbed: keys, tokens, connection strings, emails
- **Not** scrubbed: names, phone numbers, file contents — treat like shell history
- Leaves machine only on **Draft Skill** / **Revise** (your agent, your model)

**Slide 8 — Known Limits & Where To Go**
- Task split across chats → two half-tasks (no cross-chat linking)
- Two tasks with no prompt between → look like one
- Draft reads one run (the first) — use the note field for what later runs taught you
- Strict matching by design: false merge > false split
- Docs: `docs/usage.md`, `docs/privacy.md`, `docs/architecture.md`

Want me swap order, cut to 6 slides, or add demo slide?
